description: All 19 colors declared by the real build. Extracted verbatim from tailwind.config.js theme.extend.colors. No color appears here that is not in that file.

black.usage: page background on /security, /about, both legal routes; default text on light sections

white.usage: light page background, light text on dark sections

day.usage: alias of white, used only by the Button `heroSolid`/`day` variants

night.usage: html root color; Button light/scrolled label color; Button dark hover background

sun.usage: accent — mega-menu hover arrow, integrations active pager dot

dawn.usage: Used ONLY by the /platform stackedMasthead rail gradient (`from-dawn`/`via-dawn`). Zero uses on the homepage. 2 utility references total in src/.

dust.usage: press-banner background; stats-grid gradient endpoint; Button light background; dustToWhite gradient start

sand.usage: Button light/day hover background; career-listing CTA hover

dusk.usage: Button dark border; platform masthead de-emphasised heading span (text-dusk/60)

midnight.usage: Button `dark` variant background, and the cookie-notice panel background. 2 utility references in src/.

desert.usage: Blur ellipse decoration fill: the /platform featureCallout top ellipse and the industry navMasthead hero ellipse layer A. 2 utility references in src/. Zero uses on the homepage.

bone.usage: DECLARED ONLY. 0 utility references anywhere in src/ (verified by an exhaustive grep over bg-/text-/border-/fill-/from-/to-/via-/decoration-/ring-/shadow-/outline- prefixes). NOT promoted to any semantic role.

stroke-1.usage: hairline/bracket colour on LIGHT surfaces (square-bracket currentColor)

stroke-3.usage: hairline/bracket colour on DARK surfaces (square-bracket currentColor)

ink.usage: hero section background. Ad-hoc hex in the original markup, promoted to a named token by the clone.

panel.usage: integrations panel card background and its two edge-mask gradient endpoints.

matrix.usage: stats-grid decorative 2x11 bar matrix border + fill.

gradients.note: Every gradient on the site interpolates `in oklab` (and two use oklch stops). Tailwind v3 cannot emit either, so all of them ship as inline `style` backgroundImage strings. They are recorded here because they are real design values, but they are NOT Tailwind utilities.

I2.dust-to-white.$value: linear-gradient(to bottom in oklab, rgb(251,246,236) 0px, rgb(255,255,255) 100%)

I4.logoshowcase-mask-left.$value: linear-gradient(to right in oklab, rgb(255,255,255) 0px, rgba(0,0,0,0) 100%)

I5.logoshowcase-mask-right.$value: linear-gradient(to left in oklab, rgb(255,255,255) 0px, rgba(0,0,0,0) 100%)

utilityUsageCounts._method: grep -rohE '(bg|text|border|fill|from|to|via|decoration|ring|shadow|outline)-<name>(/[0-9]+)?\b' over src/ — ink/panel/matrix are applied as raw hexes inline and so are not countable this way.
